title.en: Euro profile cylinder in a mortise case (DIN)
title.zh: 欧标槽型锁芯 + 插芯锁体（DIN）

summary.en: The most standardised lock family on earth. A 17 mm × 33 mm profile cylinder sits in a mortise case built to DIN 18251, driven by an 8 mm square spindle, with a 72 mm centre distance on interior doors. If you design one adapter well, you cover most of continental Europe.
summary.zh: 全球标准化程度最高的锁族。17 × 33 mm 槽型锁芯装在符合 DIN 18251 的插芯锁体内，由 8 mm 方轴驱动，室内门中心距为 72 mm。把一个适配件做好，就能覆盖欧洲大陆的绝大部分门。

en: Profile cylinder — the replaceable keyed barrel, keyed both sides or with a thumb-turn inside
Mortise case — the box mortised into the door edge, holding the latch and deadbolt
Cam — the tab on the cylinder that throws the deadbolt
Follower — the 8 mm square hole the spindle passes through to retract the latch
Faceplate — the strip visible on the door edge
Strike plate — the pocket in the frame
zh: 锁芯：可更换的带钥匙圆筒，可双钥匙，也可内侧带旋钮
锁体：嵌入门边的盒体，容纳斜舌与方舌
凸轮：锁芯上拨动方舌的拨片
方轴孔（follower）：方轴穿过以 retract 斜舌的 8 mm 方孔
面板：门边可见的金属条

typical.en: 55 mm (interior), 60 mm; 65 / 70 / 80 mm on exterior and older doors
typical.zh: 55 mm（室内）、60 mm；外门与旧门为 65 / 70 / 80 mm

tolerance.zh: ±1 mm 内多数锁体仍可装

how.en: Door edge to the centre of the cylinder hole.
how.zh: 从门边到锁芯孔中心的距离。

typical.en: 72 mm interior, 92 mm exterior; 78 / 85 mm on older doors
typical.zh: 室内门 72 mm，外门 92 mm；旧门为 78 / 85 mm

tolerance.en: None — this is the number that decides handle fit
tolerance.zh: 无公差——把手能否装上由它决定

how.en: Centre of the spindle hole to centre of the cylinder hole.
how.zh: 方轴孔中心到锁芯孔中心的距离。

typical.en: 20 × 235 mm or 24 × 235 mm; 24 × 280 mm on fire doors

how.en: Width and length of the strip on the door edge.

tolerance.en: Must be exact, in 5 mm steps
tolerance.zh: 必须精确，以 5 mm 为步进

how.en: From the centre screw to each end, measured on the installed cylinder.
how.zh: 在装好的锁芯上，从中央固定螺钉向两端分别测量。

typical.en: 8 mm square (7 mm exists on older hardware)
typical.zh: 8 mm 方形（旧五金有 7 mm）

how.en: Measure at the lock, not at the corner.
how.zh: 在锁的位置测量，不要在门角。

notes.en: This is the best-served family for retrofit because the cylinder is a separate, standardised, replaceable part. Check two things first: does the cylinder have an emergency (double-clutch) function, and does the thumb-turn protrude enough to clamp.
notes.zh: 这是改造生态最完善的锁族，因为锁芯是独立、标准化、可更换的部件。先确认两件事：锁芯是否为双离合应急功能，以及内侧旋钮是否突出到足以夹持。

en.q: Why does 72 mm matter so much?
en.a: Because the handle is drilled at that spacing. A 72 mm handle on a 92 mm case cannot be fitted without redrilling the door, which on a fire door is not allowed.

en.q: What does 30/10 mean on a cylinder?
en.a: The distance from the central fixing screw to each end: 30 mm outside, 10 mm inside. Order the two numbers separately, never just the total.

en.q: What is an emergency function cylinder?
en.a: A double-clutch cylinder that can still be opened from outside with a key even when a key is inserted inside. Every retrofit motor that leaves a key in the cylinder needs one.

zh.q: 为什么 72 mm 这么重要？
zh.a: 因为把手是按这个孔距钻孔的。72 mm 的把手装不到 92 mm 的锁体上，除非重新钻孔——而防火门上不允许这样做。

zh.q: 锁芯上的 30/10 是什么意思？
zh.a: 指从中央固定螺钉到两端的距离：外侧 30 mm，内侧 10 mm。下单要分别写两个数，不能只写总长。
即双离合锁芯：即使内侧插着钥匙，外侧仍能用钥匙开启。凡是会在锁芯里留钥匙的改造电机，都必须配这种锁芯。
